title: The Pu inequality and the Viterbo conjecture with finite symmetry
summary: We study a construction for producing Finsler metrics on the sphere from convex bodies in $\mathbb{R}^4$ using the quaternions. Among several applications, we prove the weak Viterbo conjecture for convex bodies in $\mathbb{R}^4$ that are invariant under the natural action of the quaternion group $Q$. This is the first instance where Viterbo's systolic inequality is established for convex bodies with a finite group symmetry, addressing a question of Haim-Kislev-Ostrover.
